intro: Cricket is the biggest sport in Bangladesh, and the national team plays in front of passionate crowds.

chapters.title: Cricket
text: Bangladesh became a Test nation in 2000. Shakib Al Hasan became one of the world's best all-rounders. The women's team won the Asia Cup in 2018.

chapters.title: Other sports
text: Kabaddi is the national sport. Football is popular too, and many fans support Brazil or Argentina during World Cups.
